desc: The METE SF One Series is engineered for excellence, starting with its 1913 Picatinny rail for easy accessory mounting and an integrated flared magwell for lightning-fast reloads. Experience a crisp, precise shot every time thanks to the short reset SA trigger. This pistol is optics ready, featuring a Shield RMS/RMSc footprint and a Co-Witness slide to perfectly align your chosen optic with the standard 3-Dot white sights. Protected by a durable Cerakote finish, the package is complete with a One Series pistol case, magazine, extra backstrap, Canik mini tool kit, and optic interface adapters.
